reasoning: This is a Kubernetes operator project. The AI Grid Network (AGN) is a distributed control plane that runs as a Kubernetes operator ('grid-operator') managing CRDs (GridNetwork, GridSite, InferenceProvider). It watches Kubernetes resources, discovers peers via SWIM gossip protocol, propagates state via CRDTs, scores inference backend candidates, and writes routing overlay ConfigMaps consumed by the Praxis AI gateway. The workspace contains a dedicated 'operator' crate with K8s controllers, CRD definitions, and an operator binary (operator/src/main.rs, operator/src/crd/, operator/src/controller/). It uses the kube-rs SDK (k8s-openapi + kube crates) and deploys via Helm charts. While the workspace also includes supporting crates (scoring, swim, crdt, certs, mock-providers), the primary artifact is the Kubernetes operator that orchestrates the AI inference mesh.
